response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced, staff-level full-stack engineer with strong TypeScript/Node.js credentials and a long track record of technical leadership, mentoring, and open-source work. However, he lacks the core requirement of 8+ years building AI-driven solutions — his only AI/agentic exposure is a few months at his current role (since April 2025) working on MCP tooling. There is no evidence of Python proficiency, RAG architectures, vector databases, multi-agent frameworks, or building AI systems on major cloud platforms, all of which are required or key technologies for this role.
strengths: 15+ years of staff/senior-level software engineering experience with strong technical leadership and mentoring track record
Current hands-on exposure to MCP (Model Context Protocol) and agentic workflow tooling, directly relevant to the job's key technologies
Deep full-stack versatility (web, mobile, embedded, DevOps) suggesting strong ability to integrate AI products into diverse customer infrastructure
concerns: No demonstrated 8+ years of AI-driven solution development — AI/agentic work only began a few months ago
No evidence of Python experience, RAG architectures, vector databases, or multi-agent frameworks (LangGraph, CrewAI, etc.)
Minimal cloud platform experience (only brief AWS CDK mention) with no indication of building AI systems on AWS/GCP/Azure

key_factors.factor: Lack of AI/GenAI domain experience (RAG, vector DBs, multi-agent frameworks)
No demonstrated Python experience and limited cloud AI system-building experience
Strong staff-level technical leadership, mentoring, and full-stack engineering background
